contexts.text: Horses, chariots, coaches etc. () = intellectual, doctrinal things, etc.

Horses, and carriages, etc. () = all these things according to the understanding of the Word, and doctrine thence derived, etc. ... Chariots = doctrine from the Word; hence carriages have a similar signification.
May be likened to those who are borne in a chariot or carriage upon thin ice.

Carriages () = goods from a rational origin, because they are drawn by horses, by which are signified truths from that origin; for carriages are a kind of chariot, and by chariots are signified doctrinal things.
